subject.title: fix: active-memory recalls from all agents serialize on one shared lane

question: Should Active Memory intentionally allow one simultaneous embedded recall per agent without an additional gateway-wide cap?
rationale: The patch correctly removes cross-agent serialization, but it also changes process-wide recall capacity from one slot to as many slots as active agents; tests and green CI cannot decide that operational tradeoff.

options.title: Accept per-agent slots
options.body: Approve one simultaneous recall per agent after inspectable final-head runtime proof confirms stable multi-agent behavior.

options.title: Require aggregate cap
options.body: Add a gateway-wide Active Memory recall limit while preserving per-agent fairness if unrestricted active-agent fan-out is not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Accept per-agent slots
recommendation.body: Approve one simultaneous recall per agent after inspectable final-head runtime proof confirms stable multi-agent behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history shows the broadest involvement in Active Memory runtime and queue-adjacent behavior.
